known_issues: Answer-key leak (DEBUG-HARDENING.md section 0): the composite starters used to ship Automate/docs/release-notes.md entries naming the reverted fixes. Verified for this task on the current tree: grep for 'mini-fridge', 'zero-size', 'GetMachineStates' and 'seed behavior' in benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/stardew-automate-release-regressions/environment/StardewMods/Automate/docs/release-notes.md and in the Hub workspace returns nothing; all four entries are gone. The leak is therefore closed for the starter that E0 materialises (commit a483c85, which precedes the catalog 1.1.0 bump b5915a1; the prepared 1.1.0 image bakes the scrubbed notes too).

Report #216 never says the stuck output has an empty stack; the fixture produces the wedge only by setting heldObject.Stack = 0 (SuiteComposite.cs:160). DEBUG-HARDENING.md section 6 records the competing reading: 'a broken item' can be read as an item with missing data (the codebase has `catch (KeyNotFoundException) // invalid/broken item` in ChestContainer). A repair of that reading is rejected although the report as written admits it.

benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/stardew-automate-release-regressions/tests/SuiteComposite.cs:78 only asserts GetMachineStates(farm, whole map).Any() after 360 idle ticks. One reported tile (the shipping bin) satisfies it; the report's other location ('a shed full of kegs'), the completeness of the result ('all the machines that were missing') and the state values are never checked. NOTES.md risk register ('Task 3 confound') warns that the unfixed tree passes this probe spuriously if any automated group exists when the save loads; in the E0 baseline the starter fails it, so the confound did not occur with the fixture save.

benchmarks/stardew-core/catalog.json:207 publishes a diagnosis the exam withholds (brief: 'Restore mini-fridge, API scan, malformed-output, and Junimo configuration behavior.'); the text is copied into the Hub's public tasks.json. The exam itself gives observations only.

The prepared evaluator image used for the E0 runs (sha256:fc201c743dc9) bakes /opt/gcb/harness with the SuiteRunner that predates commit 276a070: there a throwing wait predicate is treated as SATISFIED (`return true`) instead of failing the case (repo version: benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/harness/GcbHarness/Framework/SuiteRunner.cs:80-95). Predicates that can throw in this suite: ApiReportsGroup `_api!` (SuiteComposite.cs:111), MachineResumes `_brokenFurnace!` (:172). In each of them the statement after the wait dereferences the same null/throwing object, so the case still fails under the old runner; no spurious pass was found, but the image does not contain the fix the repository claims.

Case order is load-bearing (suite class comment): 'furnace output is collected back into the mini-fridge' and 'the machine resumes ...' fail whenever the case before them failed, so each of #211 and #216 contributes two correlated failures, not two independent observations.
